construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

The state report lists planning file SP22-016 at 99 Pullman Wy. In the City of San Jose permit layer, SP22-016 (filed 2022-05-04, approved 2026-07-15) is at 7246 Sharon Dr, APN 372-21-003: a Special Use Permit for ten detached live-work units (about 23,248 sq ft living, 2,712 sq ft commercial) replacing an approximately 9,960 sq ft office building; tentative map T22-017 subdivides that 0.56-gross-acre lot into 10 residential lots and a common lot.

City permit records for 99 Pullman Wy (APN 456-41-005), owner and applicant Coastal Properties Pullman Way LLC: H22-010 Site Development Permit to allow continued use of three existing warehouse structures (about 16,000 sq ft) built without permits, filed 2022-03-18, under review; ER22-053 filed 2022-03-04. No residential permit is shown for that parcel.

MLS ML82054389 (Benjamin Wang, Lexicon Homes) markets the site as 10 detached townhouses ready to build under GP21-004/C21-009 and SP22-016/T22-017: four-story detached units of 3,240 to 3,270 sq ft each with common walkways, driveways and guest parking. Active at $10,500,000 after a $1,500,000 reduction.
